title: A White Forest cake for a December lunch in Vineyard or Riverstone, eggless
summary:
White Forest is Black Forest's paler sibling: cream and cherries against white chocolate, not dark. 100% eggless, made fresh to order at Num Num's Riverstone.

For a long December lunch in Vineyard, Tallawong or Riverstone, that matters. Vegetarian relatives and the cousin with an egg allergy eat the same slice as everyone else. Nobody has to ask what's in the sponge, and nobody gets handed the fruit platter instead.

Order with 2 days' notice. Pick up from Riverstone Shopping Centre, where the car park is free. Pickup only.

No eggs. Not in the sponge, not in the cream. That's the point. 🎂
keywords: cake vegetarian and egg-allergic guests can all eat
